description:
Biferi, once a slave, and Louise, a noble, grew up together like brothers. Yet Biferi harbored feelings for Louise that he could no longer hide, and so he suddenly left. Years later, the two cross paths again, one as a pirate and the other as a naval captain…

[Original Manhwa](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=3381263)

**Notes:**  
[*Nocturne*](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/s09bf7b) is the second short stories of series [*Lastwo's Short Stories*](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/7twyrmu).
